ops.body:
Accessor contract, from the lane that built it — brief the wiring lane with
this, it is not inferable from the signature.

Zero assumptions about the consumer: `StrandedCredentialRecoveries()` returns a
sorted snapshot copy taken under the existing mutex. Non-blocking, no channels,
callable at any cadence from any goroutine. `Cause` is a rendered string;
`Token` is informational.

THE SEMANTIC THE UI MUST GET RIGHT: **the fence is lazy.** Entries clear on a
successful retry-at-access, or on discovering the row settled externally. So a
listed account may well be recoverable on first touch — it is not known-broken,
it is known-to-have-strand ed-once-and-not-yet-retried.

Render it as "recovery pending retry", never "account broken". The list is
last-known strands, not a live health probe. A status surface that reports it
as a failure state will send operators chasing accounts that would heal
themselves the moment anything touched them.
